title: AVERAGEX when the expression is BLANK for every row: BLANK or 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", AVERAGEX ( V, IF ( V[N] > 100, V[N] ) ) )

source.quote: When Table has no rows, or Expression returns BLANK for all the rows, the function returns BLANK .
source.supports: DAX Guide: all BLANK gives BLANK

source.quote: When there are rows, but none of them meet the specified criteria, then the function returns 0.
source.supports: the Microsoft page can be read as giving 0 here

derivation: No N is above 100, so the expression is BLANK for all 7 rows. DAX Guide says the result is then BLANK.
alternative: Reading the Microsoft sentence as covering this case, the result is 0: [r] would be 0.0 (double).
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says what type an all-BLANK result has.
